headline: Terpel Signs JET A/A1 Fuel Purchase Contract with Ecopetrol
summary: Terpel subscribed to a contract with Ecopetrol S.A. to purchase JET A/A1 fuel valued at $520.039 million, running from December 1, 2026, to February 28, 2027.
why: Large commodity supply agreements between major regional energy distributors and producers dictate operational cost structures and fuel availability.

impacts.name: Ecopetrol SA
impacts.why: The supply contract secures substantial fuel sales revenue for Ecopetrol.
